newsitem.title: HAITI: At least five dead in Haiti violence.
newsitem.headline: At least five dead in Haiti violence.

text.p: At least five people were killed on the outskirts of Port-au-Prince on Friday morning but details were still sketchy, U.N. officials said.
"We have a helicopter with the force commander aboard speeding to the site right now, as well as ground patrols heading to the scene to determine what happened," one official said.

Early reports to U.N. peacekeeping troops patrolling Haiti said the violence erupted around a roadblock in Croix de Bouquet. Independent Radio Metropole said gangsters shooting local residents triggered an uprising by the populace.

"We have had serious problems of vigilantism in the area," the U.N. official said. He also said there had been a recent conflict between the town's mayor, who has his own security force, and the local Haitian National Police force.

"When the HNP arrested one of the members of the mayor's security team the mayor's office threatened to attack the HNP," the U.N. official said. "Whatever happened today, there is certainly trouble brewing."
Some 1,300 U.N. troops have been patrolling Haiti in a peacekeeping mission to support the newly created Haitian police force.
